decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The double mobile classroom hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition before 28/2/04.

Condition : 5 - 5.	The teaching areas hereby approved shall be constructed so as to provide  sound attenuation against external noise, not less than 25dB(A), with windows shut and other means of ventilation provided.

Condition : 6 - 6.	The development hereby permitted shall be fully accessible for people with impaired mobility with the access doors providing a minimum clear width of 900mm and a ramp between the pavement and access doors at a gradient of not more than 1:12 and with a clear width of at least 1000mm and providing a hand rail set at not more than 600mm in height.

Condition : 7 - The development shall not take place until details of a scheme for screen planting along the western boundary, along with a management and maintenance plan, have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and all works carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 8 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
description: Installation of one double mobile classroom.
